parts.text: [Caroline]: Sounds fun! What was the best part? Do you do it often with the kids?
[Melanie]: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.
[Caroline]: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!
[Melanie]: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!
[Image URL: https://i.redd.it/hjh0wp8s721a1.jpg; BLIP caption: a photo of a fire pit with a lot of fire and sparks]
[Caroline]: Wow, Mel, that's awesome! What's your best camping memory?

[Melanie]: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.
[Image URL: https://i.redd.it/ms0tvo85cto91.jpg; BLIP caption: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a star filled sky]
[Caroline]: Cool! What did it look like?
[Melanie]: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.
[Image URL: https://i.redd.it/eqtu6adwcrfb1.jpg; BLIP caption: a photo of a plane flying in the sky with a trail of smoke coming out of it]
